---
title: "Slope Field Explorer"
subtitle: "Direction fields, solution curves, and equilibria for first-order equations x' = f(t, x)"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Enter a first-order equation $x' = f(t,x)$ or choose an example. Click anywhere in the plane to draw the solution through that point (traced forward and backward in $t$), or type an initial condition $x(t_0)=x_0$. Use the parameter sliders to explore how the slope field changes, show the curve $f=0$ and other isoclines, and, for autonomous equations, see the equilibrium solutions classified as stable, unstable, or semi-stable. The Euler's method overlay connects this page to the Numerical Methods Explorer.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
